name: Soyuz TMA-09M
about: Soyuz TMA-09M (2013-025A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STMM), launched 2013 May 28. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2013 May 29), held fixed
docked to A07725; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
